card.situation:
Solicitation for janitorial services at the Newell Building (SRAO), Boise, ID — NAICS 561720, set aside exclusively for SBA Certified WOSBs, evaluated on technical ability, past performance, and price.
Reached the owner because Red Cedar is WOSB-eligible and NAICS-matched, but the site is ~1,400 miles from the firm's Oklahoma City base, triggering the owner's 200-mile distance rule.
reasons_for: Red Cedar is WOSB-certified and NAICS 561720-matched, satisfying the set-aside eligibility gate that disqualifies most competitors [set_aside_note: 'Firm (Red Cedar Facility Services) lists WOSB among the set-asides it can claim — ELIGIBLE'].

Core technical capabilities — QCP/CMMS inspections, CIMS-GB certification, green cleaning program, OSHA 30 supervisors, window and floor care — directly address the solicitation's highest-weighted evaluation factors [8918bdf8-18a41736-p13-e3cbea93; 8918bdf8-18a41736-p7-34bdfe2f; 8918bdf8-18a41736-p13-10a353ae].

Relevant federal past performance (GSA Region 7 Oklahoma City Federal Building, state office complex, outpatient clinic) provides credible references for the past-performance evaluation factor [8918bdf8-18a41736-p51-04106e59].
reasons_against: Boise, ID is approximately 1,400 miles from Oklahoma City, hard-triggering the owner's 200-mile no-bid rule with no workforce, equipment, or mobilization capability stated for the Pacific Northwest [profile gap: rc-distance].

No bamboo or cork flooring specialized cleaning experience is documented, leaving two scored requirements unknown/partial against a solicitation that mandates specific seasonal bamboo schedules and manufacturer-compliant cork care [8918bdf8-18a41736-p9-4220d302; 8918bdf8-18a41736-p8-0d390f14].

Critical administrative readiness gaps — SAM/UEI confirmation, IPP electronic invoicing registration, and e-QIP/SF-85 background investigation processing — are unconfirmed in the firm profile, creating proposal-submission and award risk [8918bdf8-18a41736-p45-834264de; 8918bdf8-18a41736-p29-f8913642; 8918bdf8-18a41736-p6-df6f21d2].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is an SBA-certified Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) providing janitorial, custodial, floor care, and window cleaning services to federal and state facilities under NAICS 561720.

Our core capabilities align directly with the Newell Building PWS. We provide all management, supervision, W-2 staff (38 employees), equipment, and supplies — including power-driven floor scrubbers, waxing and polishing machines, and industrial vacuum cleaners — at no cost to the Government. Our green cleaning program uses ENERGY STAR® and FEMP-designated products, satisfying the solicitation's energy-efficient and COR-approved product requirements.

Quality is managed through a formal Quality Control Program supported by CIMS-GB certification and CMMS-logged scheduled and unscheduled inspections, with documented inspector titles and frequencies. Our OSHA 30-certified supervisors lead safety compliance in conformance with applicable federal, state, and local standards.

Relevant past performance includes custodial services at the Oklahoma City Federal Building (GSA Region 7), janitorial services at a state office complex (including window and carpet cleaning), and housekeeping support at an outpatient clinic (infection control and terminal cleaning). These contracts demonstrate our ability to meet federal performance standards, work-schedule submission requirements, and daily waste and recycling protocols consistent with this solicitation.

Red Cedar is prepared to establish and maintain a site-specific QCP, submit a work schedule prior to performance, and comply with all applicable federal labor and safety requirements.

Point of Contact: [Name, Title, Phone, Email]

The contractor must provide all management, supervision, staff, equipment, and supplies to perform cleaning of restrooms, showers, break rooms, offices, windows, exterior surfaces, and common areas. Services are to be performed between 4:30 p.m. and 11:30 p.m., Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays, with specialized floor-care schedules for bamboo, cork, vinyl, and carpet surfaces.
